english.title: Permit a person under 21 to drive large goods vehicle / passenger carrying vehicle in breach of licence conditions
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) knowingly permitted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), a person under the age of 21, to drive a

(A)_[large goods]_
(B)_[passenger-carrying]_

vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), in contravention of a prescribed condition to which

(C)_[his]_
(D)_[her]_

licence was subject in that **(..SPECIFY CONDITION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 114(2)of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
knowingly permitted person under the age of 21

english.notes:
(i) See regulation 15 of the Motor Vehicles (Driving Licences) Regulations 1996 for conditions attached to provisional licences and regulation 51(1) for additional conditions relating to LGV Trainee Driver's Licences.
(ii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iii) See also offence wording: H3308.
